scope: workspace production Rust source; test source and target output are excluded

exclusions.reason: Generated build output and Rust integration test source are not production Runtime implementation source.

Applied automatically by cargo-llvm-cov in addition to the pattern above. Unit tests therefore live in sibling tests.rs files rather than in inline #[cfg(test)] modules, because a filename pattern cannot exclude test code embedded in a production file.

notes: Measured with --all-features so feature-gated modules (component_wasmtime, component_web) are included. Re-measured after implement-device-resident-multi-step-cuda-decode: that change's own real-hardware-verified new code (the concat Operator, copy_tensor_admitted, resident_shape, and a new low-level dispatch_qwen_concat function bypassing the per-node Prepared-Plan path) is itself exercised by real tests (including on real CUDA hardware), but necessarily also adds a number of defensive error-handling branches (Kernel Registry selection failures, advertisement staleness, device allocation failures) that are not independently unit-tested -- real hardware/registry failure modes that are impractical to trigger deterministically in a unit test without extensive mocking of infrastructure this codebase does not otherwise mock. The net line/function coverage ratio moved down slightly (78.89% -> 78.86% lines, 79.25% -> 78.42% functions) as a real, deliberate, reviewed consequence of that trade-off, not an unnoticed regression -- both figures are taken directly from the CI quality/coverage job's own ubuntu-latest run (github.com/astorise/Magnetar/actions/runs/34690680340), matching this file's own established measurement methodology (CI-measured, not local, to avoid a platform-dependent false failure -- see the prior note below).
